reader.requirement: At --std 85 every file description entry must open with the level indicator FD followed directly by file-name-1: a file-name before FD, an FD with no file-name, a clause between FD and the file-name, and an entry with no FD are refused, while FD file-name-1 followed by any 1985 FD clause is accepted; the witness covers only the legal form.

edition-consulted.switches: below 2002 the FD level indicator must begin in area A of a fixed-form line (COBOL3734); from 2002 there are no areas; a reference-format rule beside SR1, not SR1 itself
the AS phrase of FD IS EXTERNAL (2002) is COBOL0900 at 85; a clause after file-name-1, not SR1

reader.edition-search: Read fileSection/fileDescriptionEntry (FD fileName fixed, clauses after); grep 'Edition|DialectLevel|Year' over Binding/FileDescriptionFormats.cs (none) and AreaPlacementPass.cs (ConstructRegistry FixedFormAreaAItemOutsideAreaA2002); the token order itself is the grammar's at every edition.

reader.notes: The order FD file-name-1 is fixed by the grammar rule fileDescriptionEntry at every edition; every misordered or incomplete form fails to parse. The adjacent 1985 arms (area A placement, the AS phrase) behave per the 1985 text.
